messages:
maria (PM): quick sync: we need to lock priorities for the Optimize Advisor roadmap (batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts). customer pilots are pushing for earlier delivery. thoughts?
omar (Eng): +1. list customers pushing? need to know constraints — dedicated vs hosted, model families, seq length distributions.
maria (PM): three pilots: FinAcct (high-reqs, private), ChatFlow (hosted), EduCorp (mid). FinAcct requires private + strict latency SLO.
vishal (ML): prioritization signals we should use: estimated token-savings %, p95 latency impact, and eval regression delta on prompt suite. without these can't rank features.
elain (Design): small UI ask — admins need a single place to see recommended profile, why it was suggested, and a before/after econ estimate. low friction to accept.
omar (Eng): technical tradeoffs: batching and KV caching give big econ wins but change tail latency. quant recs are model-specific and may require validated quality thresholds per model.
ryan (SRE): rollout constraints: for Dedicated we need canary on 10% of nodes, fallback to baseline model on errors, and circuit-breaker for sustained p95 > target. Also need capacity reservation plan for pilot customers.
maria (PM): proposed launch gates (candidate): 1) pilot customers onboarded + runbook, 2) token-savings >= 8% on pilot baseline, 3) no eval regressions > 3% on RTL prompt set, 4) canary rollback plan + SLO guardrails. keep or adjust?
vishal (ML): adjust gate 3 to be "no regression > 2% on critical prompts" and tie alerts to eval-trigger rulebook so ops get automated signal.
omar (Eng): agree, add performance gate: p95 increase <= 20ms for interactive workloads, else mark as 'latency-risk' and require opt-out knob.
elain (Design): for the admin UX, propose "accept recommendation" flow with preview of token/cost delta + QA link. small mock in Figma linked: https://figma.com/s/opt-advisor-mock
pm-bot: checklist created: /todo OptimizeAdvisorPilot: [define gates, infra canary, eval rulebook, pilot contracts] :white_check_mark: (assigned to maria, omar, vishal, ryan)
maria (PM): sample gate config snippet below for engineering and policy teams: ```json
{
  "feature":"optimize_advisor_v1",
  "gates":{
    "pilot_only":true,
    "min_token_savings_pct":8,
    "max_eval_regression":0.02,
    "max_p95_latency_ms":20
  },
  "notifications":{
    "eval_alert_channel":"#prod-evals",
    "on_regression":"auto-rollforward=false"
  }
}
```
omar (Eng): that config looks fine. engineering asks: define pilot matrix (customer x model x mode). I'll sketch and share before EOD.
vishal (ML): I'll prepare a small eval harness and the initial prompt suite for regressions. aiming for automated nightly checks.
ryan (SRE): I'll draft canary steps and circuit-breaker policy. need to confirm Dedicated node quotas for FinAcct.
maria (PM): next steps: Omar sketch pilot matrix, Vishal eval harness, Ryan canary runbook, Elaine admin mocks. Sync Thursday 09:30 PT to sign off gates. If anyone can't make, drop notes here.
elain (Design): noted, will share compact mocks by tomorrow. :thumbsup:
omar (Eng): noted. ping @maria when matrix is up.
maria (PM): thanks all — want to keep this scoped to core recs + alerts for the initial release. follow-ups for auto-application and advanced quant workflows in Q2. :rocket:
